note: Kiowa County KS publishes no queryable zoning district service. Zoning is handled by cities: Greensburg's official zoning map is a static PDF/image (2013 R&S Digital map; 2021 PDF map), and the City of Kiowa's zoning regulations PDF is in Barber County, not Kiowa County. County site lists no GIS or zoning service; Kansas ORKA offers parcels only. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online returned no Kiowa County or Greensburg zoning feature service. Commercial parcel vendors were not used.
